description: Owner-private immutable image admission and local diagnostic generation structural boundary. Bounded PNG/JPEG byte identities retain decoder normalization and source provenance. Rights, species and explicit pose scopes are separate owner assertions; content-bound review pins require exact live ownership, byte hashes, current permissions and terminal revocation checks. Retained discovery snapshots cannot be relabeled by review. Source/refinement semantics enforce allocation, source correspondence, review chronology and diagnostic pixel constraints. Unknown adapter pins require runtime registry rejection. Diagnostic candidates are fixture-only, generated false and nonrenderable; they do not certify legal rights, species fidelity, real generation, renderer admission or public release. No arbitrary URL fetch, model call, paid service or external upload is authorized.
